title: Listen and Choose a Response — Travel

questions.stem: Did you enjoy your trip to the mountains?

options.A: I'm planning a trip there next spring.
options.B: The views were great, but it rained most days.
options.C: The mountains are about three hours away.
options.D: Yes, I'll enjoy it a lot.

questions.explanation: A balanced description of the trip answers the question; the 'Yes' option uses the wrong tense.
